The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed. A man plants the seed in his field. That seed is the smallest of all seeds. But when it grows, it is one of the largest garden plants. It becomes a tree, big enough for the wild birds to come and make nests in its branches. Matthew 13:31-32
At St. Mary Abbots (SMA), everything we do is guided by the teaching of Jesus to ‘learn from me’ (St. Matthew 11:29).
Our vision is underpinned by Christian theology and stems from the parabolic teachings of Jesus. We live out this vision via our values of: Friendship, Peace, Compassion, Justice, Forgiveness and Endurance.
These values help us as a school community to live well together; to flourish in all things and celebrate ‘life in all its fullness’.

Thursday morning at 9.30am – School Eucharist
Next to St Mary Abbot Church is St Mary Abbots School. The children attend a Sung Eucharist every Thursday morning at 9.30am during the term.
This service is open to the public, with each class taking it in turn to participate in the service, to read the lessons and say prayers, with music led by the school choir. For special festival days, such as Ash Wednesday, Remembrance Day, Christingle, the annual Carol Service and more, the whole school takes part and the parents are encouraged to attend.
During half term or on holiday the service is replaced by a 12 noon service. Please click on the link to see our ‘Sunday and Weekdays’ service sheet for the week.

pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome – St Mary Abbots Church of England Primary School
pageCache.text:
Welcome to St. Mary Abbots School (SMA). We are a small, thriving Church of England primary school in the heart of Kensington. We are very near Kensington High Street and Kensington Church Street.
Our small school is a vibrant place, where exceptional learning happens. We want our children to love learning. We offer a rich and broad curriculum that engages the children and allows them to develop their interests. We further enhance our delivery of the curriculum through a wealth of enrichment activities, ensuring that there is always something exciting happening.
The school itself was established in 1645 as a ‘bluecoat’ charity school. It then moved to its present building in 1860. The current school building is Grade II listed so it’s an incredibly important building architecturally and we love it! It’s quirky, charming and very special to us. The school is in the churchyard of St. Mary Abbots Church and that reflects the close and important relationship we have with the church and the clergy team there.
​At SMA we pursue excellence in all that we do and have the very highest expectations of all the children. We strive to deliver teaching and learning of the highest quality, within a nurturing learning environment. The school has a dedicated, enthusiastic team of teachers and support staff, who are committed to challenging all children to achieve their very best academic outcomes.
As a single-form entry school, the staff pride themselves in knowing all the children at the school by name and creating a nurturing environment in which they can flourish. Our school is a happy and inclusive place, where children develop into confident, well-rounded individuals, with the skills and knowledge they need to be successful in life.
At SMA we have a strong sense of community. We teach our children to love one another, to work together and to be responsible citizens. We are proud of the close relationship we have with our parents, our governors and the Church. This sense of community, and indeed everything that we do, is underpinned by our Christian ethos, vision and values.
We look forward to welcoming you to St. Mary Abbots School.
Mrs. Djerehe Head Teacher
